about.title: Present
body: I'm a ceramicist based in Scotland. I make work by hand, and find most of my inspiration somewhere between the studio and the coast.

I studied ceramics at Grays School of Art, where I developed a practice rooted in material honesty and careful making. I was awarded for my work there, and it gave me the foundation to take the craft seriously.

I now work as Lead Ceramicist running the studio and teaching people at all stages of their practice. I find the teaching side genuinely rewarding - watching someone develop a feel for clay is one of those things that doesn't get old. Alongside that, I continue to develop my own collections, while experimenting within my own practice
This site is home to that work. If something resonates, I'd love to hear from you.

work.intro: I work in small runs - each piece thrown by hand and finished at its own pace. Nothing is exactly repeated. What you'll find here is my current work.

contact.intro: Whether you're interested in buying a piece, commissioning something, or just want to know more - I'm happy to hear from you. Use the form below or drop me a line directly.
contact.commissionBody: I take on a small number of commissions each year. If you have a specific form, occasion, or brief in mind, it's worth getting in touch early so we can talk it through.
